overclaims: Because the antecedent has not happened, I cannot test the prediction.
Shows weekly users rising steadily, from 500M in March 2025 to 700M in August and 800M in October.
Big-tech revenue was still rising in mid-2025.
The consequent is not scored because the antecedent did not occur.
checks.note: The evidence does not establish that the antecedent never occurred through October 2026. It covers ChatGPT usage through October 2025 only. August's figure was approaching 700 million, and three observations do not establish uninterrupted growth. Microsoft's quarterly revenue alone does not establish a big-tech revenue trend. State that a broad usage decline is not established by the cited evidence.

The payload preserves the historical scope and distinguishes unresolved hallucinations from lack of progress. It correctly limits the independent study to specific legal queries and identifies GPT-3.5 among the tested models.
